title: Guild Wars Core
wikitext:
Within the context of [[Guild Wars]], [[core]] refers to those features which are common to all [[campaign]]s, expansions, and installation, such as:

*The 252 player-usable [[List of core skills|Core skills]].
*The 6 [[profession]]s available in all campaigns: [[Warrior]], [[Ranger]], [[Monk]], [[Necromancer]], [[Mesmer]] and [[Elementalist]].
*Certain [[weapon]]s and [[crafting material]]s.
*[[The Mists]] and [[The Battle Isles]] core regions.
*[[Armor]] available from the Fissure of Woe ([[Obsidian armor|Obsidian]]).

==Notes==
{{anomaly|The [[Feedback:Game updates/20200422|April 22, 2020 update]] added ten [[elite skill]]s to the game, one for each profession. They are all classified as Core skills, despite not being limited to only the six Core professions, nor are they available in all of the individual ''[[Guild Wars]]'' installments.}}
*Core can also refer to players who regularly play [[GvG]] for their [[guild]]s (normally called a "Core Team").
*Core may also refer to the item [[Destroyer Core]] in [[Eye of the North]] (though these are often referred to as ''dcores'' in this context).
